text:
Priya (oncall): Noticing a spike of 5xxs and cache misses for the embeddings cache in eu-central starting ~09:12 UTC. Impacting ~4% of embedding lookups and causing downstream indexing delays. Declaring incident. Severity: S2. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2189007777

cache-bot: alert: embed_cache_thrash_eu-central detected at 09:12:18 UTC (miss_rate=28%, eviction_rate high).

Marco: I'm pulling eviction and OOM logs now. Early sign: rapid churn on redis-cluster shards; eviction_policy changed yesterday to allkeys-lru on some shards.

Telemetry: Query: `sum(rate(embed_cache_miss_total[1m])) by (shard)` shows shard eu-central-3 at 34% miss. Posting a short graph link: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/d/graphs/embed-cache-euc

Priya (oncall): Emergency mitigation: switching failover path to bypass cache for low-latency customers and increasing TTL on cache fills to reduce churn. Command: `infractl routing set override --path /v1/embeddings --policy bypass-cache:vip-list`

deploy-bot: routing change applied at 09:15:02 UTC 10s window: bypass-cache for vip-list. status: success.

Marco: Also rolling back the eviction-policy change made yesterday to preserve hot keys: `redis-ops apply --shard eu-central-3 --config eviction_policy=volatile-lru` (internal).

Ops Eng: Restarted one flapping cache node to clear stale state: `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/redis-euc-3` - restarted pod0.

Telemetry: After mitigations p95 latency for embeddings returned from 820ms -> 380ms and 5xx rate dropped from 4.1% -> 0.3% over 6m. Miss rate on eu-central-3 dropped to 9%.

CS: Notifying affected customers and updating status page: "Temporary degradation for embedding lookups in eu-central. We applied mitigations and are monitoring. RCA to follow." Draft: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2189007777

Priya (oncall): Next steps: Marco to lead short RCA on eviction_policy change + shard config drift; Telemetry to add alert for miss_rate > 15% sustained 5m; Ops Eng to add pre-deploy lint preventing eviction policy changes without canary. War room: 11:00 UTC.

Marco: I'll own the infra postmortem and include config diffs, recent changes, and recommendations for preflight checks.

Priya (oncall): Current status: mitigated, monitoring for 45m. Incident state: mitigated. Closing this thread unless recurrence observed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
